evals.prompt: Create a merchants guild called the Iron Cartel based in Stoneforge in the Ironpeak Mountains. They control the ore trade routes.

assertions.check: Private file has YAML with type: Organization
Private file has headquarters, region, org_type, leader, influence fields
Private file embeds public with ![[Public/World/Groups/{Group Name}]]
Private has Goals, Structure, Notable Members, Relations, DM Notes sections
Private dataview uses FROM [[]] not FROM [[#this.file.name]]
Public has Overview, Reputation, Known Members, Services sections
Public file has no DM secrets
Files follow 10-second scan rule — short bullets, 2-4 items per section

evals.prompt: Create a secret assassins guild called the Silent Veil. They operate somewhere in Crestfall but their hideout is unknown. Even their existence is a rumor.

assertions.check: Public file hides sensitive details — headquarters may show as Unknown
Public Known Members is empty or says 'None known'
Private file has fuller details about the organization
Does not auto-create NPC files for leader without asking
Tags include org_type tag for the secret society type
